name: IDRiD: Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset
description: A clinical ophthalmology benchmark dataset representative of an Indian diabetic population, consisting of 516 fundus images acquired using a digital retinal camera. Provides ground truth disease severity grading for diabetic retinopathy (5 classes) and diabetic macular edema (3 classes), as well as pixel-level manual segmentations of four primary retinal lesions: microaneurysms, hemorrhages, hard exudates, and soft exudates. Safeguard notice: Curated for research and diagnostic algorithm development; not certified as an autonomous screening device for patient management without ophthalmologist confirmation.
